title: Hydraulic platform
prompt: A labelled scale teaching model of the page 29 firefighter hydraulic platform lowers stabilizers with Stabilize. Raise uses lower-boom rams to push up its base and extends its sections, while the upper-boom ram retracts to pull up the upper-boom base and lift the cage. Lower reverses these distinct motions under controlled hydraulic movement, including extending the upper-boom ram, retracting lower sections and lowering the lower boom. See-through shows both third-class booms, pivots, ram attachment points, lower-boom extending sections and cage load. Show opposite upper- and lower-ram raising directions. Do not invent a detailed valve circuit for label count.
blurb: A scale teaching adaptation of the firefighter platform shows paired lower rams pushing and the upper ram pulling to lift a cage.
chapter: Part 1: The Mechanics of Movement / Levers
adaptation: Illustrative scale model with prescribed cage orientation, without a claimed leveling mechanism or detailed hydraulic circuit.
